delegation_mechanism.note: The config model has no agent or delegation field.

short_term_state.note: Typed state: history of EntryInput (prompt, return type, libraries) plus code.

long_term_memory.note: The disk cache persists generated code across runs but acts as memoization, not memory re-injected into prompts.

state_persistence.note: Cache restore replays code for identical prompt sequences. It is not a resume of an interrupted run.

retry_policy.note: config.retry_config covers transport retries for transient LLM errors; these are not task retries.

rollback.note: The config model has no rollback facility. reset() clears history and cache only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If no valid result is obtained, the system raises an error containing the last code produced and halts the process.
termination_condition.note: A single-shot generation otherwise ends when valid code is produced.

timeouts.note: Executor code is not in the evidence. retry_config mentions LLM timeouts only as a retry trigger.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: It may modify critical system files, execute harmful operations, or compromise the host operating system.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host process, since there is no isolation.
